system.description:
A person who travels with their trusty companion, a being they trust above all others with their life. They have long experience or the training to maximize the talents of their companion and together they are a force to be reckoned with.

The Master is the class for those who wish to fulfill the fantasy of fighting alongside a companion of their choice. As the companion can be built flexibly through skill investment, it can fulfill a variety of roles.
triggers: Your companion comforts someone in need.
You challenge another master to a duel.
complications: Something is wrong with your companion.
A nefarious organization targets your companion.
